initial_prompt: Generate a restrained editorial aviation illustration as a 3:2 landscape blog cover, composition 1536x1024. Main subject: one complete fictional high-wing four-seat single-engine piston training airplane with fixed tricycle landing gear and a two-blade propeller, seen from an elevated front-left three-quarter angle parked on a quiet small-airport apron. Both wings and the tail fully inside the frame, ample margins. Through the clear cabin glazing show two small, subtle seated pilot silhouettes in the front seats, secondary to the airplane; one looks forward and the other slightly toward the side window. No identifiable faces and no headgear drawn over eyes. A clean empty runway and low hangar in the background suggest routine proficiency flying, with no other moving traffic. Restrained somewhat abstract graphic illustration, muted slate-blue, soft cream and grey palette, simple coherent aircraft geometry, gentle daylight, light paper-like texture, composed like a serious private aviation magazine cover. No charts or diagrams on the image. No text whatsoever, no letters, numerals, registration marks, labels, branding, captions, symbols resembling typography, or watermarks. Avoid dramatic banking, clouds obscuring the airplane, exaggerated safety symbolism, cockpit close-ups or detailed instruments. It is a fictional editorial illustration, not a photo of an aircraft for sale.
refinement_prompt: Refine only the framing of this editorial cover. Keep the same fictional high-wing training airplane, two small pilot silhouettes, muted palette and illustration style. Zoom the viewpoint out enough that the WHOLE AIRPLANE including BOTH WING TIPS and complete tail is clearly inside the 3:2 frame with generous clear margins of at least 7% from every image edge. Reduce airplane size about 20% and center it. Preserve coherent wings, struts, tricycle landing gear and two-blade propeller. The right wingtip must not touch or be cut by the right frame edge. No text, numbers, logos, registration marks or watermarks. Do not add objects.
